resources.string: The message goes back to your inbox either way. If you always allow %1$s, their future messages skip every filter, including your block rules.
The messages go back to your inbox either way. If you always allow these senders, their future messages skip every filter, including your block rules.
Anyone can send a text under a name like %1$s. Allowing it also lets fake texts using that name through.
